name: browserbase
purpose: Hosted browser for Substack publish + LinkedIn People tab + DM threads. Replaces chrome-devtools-mcp.
required_for_sde: optional — without browserbase OR chrome-devtools, Substack publish breaks. LinkedIn/X/Reddit publishing via composio still works.
cost: Free Hobby tier (~60 min/mo) likely sufficient for typical use. Upgrade to Starter (~$39/mo) only if you exceed ~60 browser minutes/month.

steps.prompt: Sign up for browserbase. Press ENTER when at dashboard.

manual_install: Settings → API Keys → generate one → copy
Copy Project ID from project settings or dashboard
